summary: Implemented the rich.progress open/wrap_file feature. Changes: rich/progress.py (private _ProgressReader and _ReadContext, module-level open and wrap_file, Progress.open and Progress.wrap_file with overloads); tests/test_progress.py (19 new tests before the script-entry block); docs/source/progress.rst (two new subsections under Advanced usage); CHANGELOG.md (one Unreleased Added bullet, PR 1759). Nothing committed. Tests, mypy and black were not run because the task forbade running repository code, so everything was verified by reading only. Choices: io.open used inside Progress.open to avoid the module-level open shadowing the builtin; shared private helper _make_read_progress builds the display; write raises io.UnsupportedOperation("write"); one test uses a type-ignore for a None task total.
